narrative: Today's brief highlights significant progress in AI, particularly concerning agent development and deployment safety. Technology sectors see innovation in delivery, infrastructure, and user privacy, while space science continues to explore lunar crop growth and orbital safety. Developer tools and open-source contributions also show steady advancements.

highlights.whyItMatters: DoorDash unveiled the six-propeller aircraft that will be used in its new drone delivery business at its annual Dash Forward 2026 event.

highlights.title: NASA, International Partners Advance Work on Space Crops
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA, CSA (Canadian Space Agency), and the German Aerospace Center signed a joint statement of intent to begin coordinated, preparatory work toward an Earth-based demonstrator to learn how to grow crops on the Moon.

highlights.title: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now supports direct querying of Apache Iceberg and Parquet data in your data lake
highlights.whyItMatters: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now lets you directly query Apache Iceberg and Parquet data stored in your data lake alongside live operational data—no ETL pipelines required. Powered by DuckDB embedded within Aurora, this capability enables single queries that join transactional and historical data using familiar PostgreSQL syntax. It supports AWS Glue Data Catalog, S3, and S3 Tables, with optimizations like predicate pushdown and caching for efficient performance.
